values.note: A night: power (15-amp) $38 (67 sites). GST included. 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' Firewood $10 a bin at the registration booth. The campground's Alberta Parks page (updated Jul 17, 2026), read 2026-11-10.

note: Dunvegan Provincial Park on the Peace River flats beside the Hwy 2 bridge: lightly treed individual and double/shared sites below the valley slopes, next to the Historic Dunvegan fur-trade site and market gardens, with campground and riverside trails and a playground. Tap water is shut off for the season before the campground closes (September 23 in 2026). A payphone is at the registration booth; no cell service. --Claude
